findings: All features complete and integrated. Eight architectural concerns identified for post-deployment refinement: (1) print route lacks authentication, (2) concurrent resident ID generation has theoretical race condition, (3) barangay resident counts may include archived residents, (4) sidebar navigation lacks permission guards, (5) soft-delete-only strategy may confuse users, (6) report filters lack permission checks, (7) age calculation lacks month precision, (8) CSV export lacks data validation. None are blocking. Models, controllers, routes, views, seed data, and HBS helpers all implemented correctly. Role-based access control enforced on write operations. Activity logging captures all mutations. 18 barangays and 15 test residents seeded. Integrates cleanly with existing SmartCivi architecture.
